title: Typical Angina, Reversed: A Long-Standing Documentation Error in the UCI Heart Disease Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.33248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The UCI Heart Disease data are a widely used machine-learning benchmark. We show that their chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation. At all four sites, the code documented as "asymptomatic" (4) marks patients with typical angina, and the code documented as "typical angina" (1) marks patients with almost none of the classical angina features (at Cleveland, no chest pain).   Two complementary checks establish this: (i) the chest-pain table and regression coefficients of the original 1986 Cleveland study are reproduced only under the corrected reading; (ii) in the Budapest, Switzerland and Long Beach files, 93-96% of patients coded 4 have all three classical angina features. A 1990 word-labeled Cleveland file already uses the documented labels, and Statlog (Heart), a Cleveland subset, stores the same codes. translated_title: 典型心绞痛，反转了：UCI心脏病数据集中一个长期存在的文档标注错误
translated_abstract: UCI心脏病数据集是广泛使用的机器学习基准数据集。我们发现其胸痛变量的存储方式与其文档说明相反。在所有四个数据采集站点，被文档标注为“无症状”（代码4）的编码实际标记的是典型心绞痛患者，而被文档标注为“典型心绞痛”（代码1）的编码实际标记的是几乎没有经典心绞痛特征的患者（在克利夫兰站点即为无胸痛的患者）。两项互补的验证确立了这一发现：（i）原始1986年克利夫兰研究的胸痛表格和回归系数只有在纠正后的解读下才能复现；（ii）在布达佩斯、瑞士和长滩的数据文件中，93-96%编码为4的患者具备全部三项经典心绞痛特征。一份1990年带有文字标签的克利夫兰文件已经使用了文档所述的标签，而作为克利夫兰数据子集的Statlog (Heart)也存储了相同的编码。OpenML、PMLB以及两个高票数的Kaggle副本（这些副本命名了类别）使用了相同的文档标签（约40……
tldr: UCI心脏病数据集的胸痛变量编码与其文档说明完全相反——“无症状”实际代表典型心绞痛患者，“典型心绞痛”实际代表无胸痛患者，这是一个通过复现原始1986年研究和多站点数据交叉验证所证实的长期存在的标注错误。
en_tdlr: The UCI Heart Disease dataset's chest-pain variable is stored in reverse of its documentation—the "asymptomatic" code actually marks typical angina patients and vice versa—a long-standing labeling error verified by reproducing the original 1986 Cleveland study and cross-checking multiple site data files.
